summary: A highly sophisticated phishing attempt impersonating State Bank of India (SBI) using a fake KYC verification pretext to harvest netbanking credentials and OTPs.

scoreBreakdown.name: Credential Harvesting Vectors
scoreBreakdown.description: Direct solicitation of passwords, OTP tokens, NetBanking PINs, or card CVVs.

scoreBreakdown.name: Brand & Authority Impersonation
scoreBreakdown.description: Visual or textual mimicry of reputable institutions (banks, government, logistics).

scoreBreakdown.name: Urgency Manipulation
scoreBreakdown.description: Artificial deadline ('within 24 hours', immediate disconnect) designed to bypass critical thinking.

scoreBreakdown.name: Suspicious Destination / TLD
scoreBreakdown.description: Disposable top-level domain, deceptive subdomains, or unverified routing path.

scoreBreakdown.name: Homograph / Direct-IP Evasion
scoreBreakdown.description: Punycode domain mimicry or raw IP server routing.

scoreBreakdown.name: Multimodal Visual Anomalies
scoreBreakdown.description: Disproportionate logos, fake trust badges, or spoofed OS notification shell.

signals.evidence: High-risk top-level domain associated with disposable scams: .xyz
Brand spoofing: mentions 'SBI' in host 'sbi-kyc-verify.netbanking-update.xyz', but official domain is onlinesbi.sbi, sbi.co.in

visualIndicators.label: Fake Brand Header
visualIndicators.whyItMatters: Uses official-looking branding to establish immediate, false trust with the victim.

visualIndicators.label: Panic Inducer
visualIndicators.whyItMatters: The red warning box and 'CRITICAL' language are designed to trigger an emotional response and bypass logical scrutiny.

visualIndicators.label: Malicious Domain
visualIndicators.whyItMatters: The URL uses a suspicious '.xyz' TLD and a deceptive subdomain structure to mimic a legitimate banking site.

visualIndicators.label: Credential Harvesting Form
visualIndicators.whyItMatters: Directly requests highly sensitive information including NetBanking passwords and mobile numbers for OTP interception.

digitalIndicators.notes: High-risk TLD (.xyz) frequently abused in phishing campaigns.
Impersonates SBI using an unverified domain.

attackPattern: Impersonation of a major financial institution (SBI).
Deployment of a high-pressure 'Account Suspended' narrative.
Redirection to a fraudulent domain (netbanking-update.xyz) via a deceptive URL.
Collection of CIF numbers, passwords, and mobile numbers to facilitate unauthorized account access and OTP theft.

explanations.title: Deceptive URL Structure
explanations.description: The domain is not an official SBI domain. It uses a non-standard TLD (.xyz) and attempts to hide the true domain behind multiple subdomains.

explanations.title: Artificial Urgency
explanations.description: The attacker uses a strict time limit to force the user into making a mistake without verifying the source.
explanations.extractedQuote: Complete online e-KYC within 24 hours to prevent permanent deactivation.

explanations.title: Credential Theft
explanations.description: The form is designed to capture the exact combination of data needed to hijack a bank account.

do: Navigate to the official SBI website by manually typing 'onlinesbi.sbi' into your browser.
Use the official SBI YONO mobile application for all banking tasks.
Report this phishing attempt to the official SBI cybersecurity department and your local cybercrime cell.
doNot: Do not click on any links provided in suspicious emails, SMS, or websites.
Do not enter your NetBanking password, CIF, or OTP on any website that does not have a verified, official domain.
Do not trust 'SSL Secured' claims on suspicious websites; attackers can easily use SSL certificates on fraudulent sites.
